scope: All 170 frozen baseline Shell files. No executable changes in S0.
referenceMethod: Literal basename references in tracked text files plus manual dynamic-import and scenario review. Ambiguous basenames explicitly marked. Graph absence does not prove absence of Shell callers.

dynamicImportReview.resolution: The certification_lib loop enumerates nine literal helper names at lines 66-75. Resolve those names to scripts/lib. Their basename occurrences appear in the per-file index.
The helper parameter writes a source command into a temporary fake runner. Preserve the external execution seam in replacement tests, not the shell source statement.
interfaces_module binds the critical-consumer test-interfaces helper. This test has no inbound literal reference but protects current public execution-fixture behavior.
phase_graph_lib binds local-certification-phase-graph.sh; kubernetes_lib binds the Kubernetes helper. Both variable imports need replacement test coverage.

cdc.futureOwner: Jupiter CDC integration against real Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Connect
cdc.reason: Keep exact event identity and baselines. Retire old fake CLI plumbing only after equivalent negative behavior.

retired.futureOwner: No replacement for historical checklist shape
retired.reason: Retire archived phase-shape checks. Preserve any still-current domain constraint through R03.

images.futureOwner: Existing image tools plus managed build tasks and lifecycle tests
images.reason: Preserve registry and kind-load transports and image execution identity. Retain useful operation tools.

policy.futureOwner: Necessary architecture and transaction acceptance checks in existing verification tasks
policy.reason: Retire completed checklist assertions only. Preserve current transaction, Account v2, and offline-reference invariants.

hooks.futureOwner: Existing local hook tools and necessary Gradle/source checks
hooks.reason: Preserve hook behavior and immutable analysis policy. No broad tooling migration solely for statistics.

flyway.futureOwner: Service migration/JDBC tests and managed Flyway tasks
flyway.reason: Preserve all service migration owners, constraints, and index-plan requirements. Keep external operator commands when needed.

critical.futureOwner: Deployed Jupiter scenarios using FIX, operator HTTP, Kafka, and durable SQL
critical.reason: Migrate shared observations through scenario batches. Preserve quarantine, identity, one-owner, and restoration requirements.

gateway-recovery.futureOwner: One deployed resting BUY plus same-owner Gateway recovery
gateway-recovery.reason: Keep FIX session/WAL/PVC continuity and actual post-recovery business retry.

matching-recovery.futureOwner: One deployed resting BUY plus Matching replacement/cancel/redelivery
matching-recovery.reason: Prove actual replacement, replay, a new cancel, and singular durable effects after controlled redelivery.

market-stream.futureOwner: Market projection and public stream recovery Jupiter scenarios
market-stream.reason: Preserve deterministic snapshots, Redis repair, public-client signals, consumer restoration, and isolation.

market-verdict.futureOwner: Pure Java evidence evaluator tested through its public interface
market-verdict.reason: Replace the seven-condition verdict and negative fixtures. Do not start infrastructure.

query.futureOwner: Query deployed scenarios with current authenticated business envelopes
query.reason: Reuse the existing Java verdict. Migrate observers and fixtures without restoring retired Redis business reads.

cluster.futureOwner: Narrow kind/registry lifecycle operations with behavior tests
cluster.reason: Retain operational CLI or helper where useful. Move test verdicts to Jupiter and preserve exact ownership.

dependencies.futureOwner: Dependency loss and retained Connect diagnostic scenarios
dependencies.reason: Reuse existing Java recovery evaluator. Retain node execution checks and focused diagnostic limits.

alias.futureOwner: Canonical task or documented current entry point
alias.reason: Remove delegation-only compatibility aliases after updating actual and documented callers.

aggregate.futureOwner: Gradle complete verification and a compact current-run result summary
aggregate.reason: Remove custom Shell dispatch after all callers, ordering, readers, and selected-requirement checks migrate.

resources.futureOwner: Resource observations and preflight exercised through lifecycle tests
resources.reason: Keep resource measurement and exact cleanup. Merge redundant source-shape checks, not safety behavior.

placement.reason: Reuse existing Java verdict and public minimal diagnostics. Preserve readiness/liveness and restoration distinctions.

matching.futureOwner: Existing native executables plus deployed Matching Jupiter scenarios
matching.reason: Preserve all required fault modes and native integrity checks. Report measurements without invented TPS thresholds.

schemas.futureOwner: Pinned rendered-manifest validation plus semantic Jupiter checks
schemas.reason: Kubeconform replaces schema responsibility only. Preserve topic, storage, TLS, selector, and probe semantics.

external.futureOwner: Existing external-certification tasks and narrow operator launchers
external.reason: Preserve opt-in external checks and their scope. The complete local task uses local-equivalent required behavior.

rm1.futureOwner: One deployed Risk-to-Matching Jupiter scenario using owned environment operations
rm1.reason: Preserve durable admission/outbox and exact matching.commands evidence. Do not extend the claim to filled trading or replay.

query-tls.futureOwner: Query Spring starter tests and Testcontainers TLS/ACL fixtures
query-tls.reason: Move credential preparation into a bounded fixture. Retain hostname, trust, authentication, and command ACL negatives.

deletionPolicies.retained-tool: Retain at or below current line ceiling. Move scenario verdicts to the authoritative test owner. Preserve useful operator interface and update imports.
deletionPolicies.historical-shape: Update direct and documented callers. Preserve any current R03 invariant before retiring historical checklist shape.
deletionPolicies.replacement: Exercise assigned requirements and necessary negative cases. Update all callers and evidence readers, then delete the old Shell path and obsolete dedicated scaffolding.
deletionPolicies.shared-final-consumer: Introduce replacement behavior in replacementIntroductionBatch. Migrate delivered scenario callers immediately. Replace any needed old path with a narrow compatibility adapter, retaining no duplicated verdict logic. Delete this final path only in S5-G after every runtime, test, build, and documented consumer migrates.
